title: From PM at Stripe to Building an AI startup, a recent founder's journey - Mounir Mouawad
talk_summary: A founder's narrative talk about transitioning from PM roles at Stripe/Google/Amazon to founding an open-source agent SDK startup, framed through video-game analogies. It covers user discovery in AI, velocity as table stakes, and the difficulty of go-to-market without big-brand scaffolding, but contains no engineering or operational techniques.

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of 3-6 month roadmaps, the team makes directional bets and iterates fast based on user reaction, using hypotheses as the anchor for focus.
takeaways.evidence_quote: your anchor for you and the rest of your team is is really just hypothesisdriven um deliberate iteration

takeaways.what_they_do: Goes from a new external development (e.g., MCP) to idea, spec, design, testing, and release in hours-to-days by removing multi-department sign-off gates.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you'll go from like something happened like MCP is out ... to having an idea a spec um a product spec an design um some testing and release
takeaways.numbers: hours to days from idea to release
